# Resume Builder
> Free online resume builder. No account required. Data stays in your browser. ATS-friendly templates. PDF export.

## About
resumebuilder.ramannagar.in is a free, privacy-first resume builder built for job seekers.
- No sign-up or account required
- Resume data stored only in the browser (localStorage) — never sent to any server
- ATS-friendly templates: Classic, Modern, Minimal, Executive, Creative
- One-click PDF export
- Built by Raman Nagar (https://ramannagar.in)

## Pages

- /builder: Resume editor — the main app

- /templates/creative-resume-template: Creative resume template with colorful sidebar and skill chips

- /blog/resume-summary-examples: 20 resume summary examples for every industry

- /terms: Terms of use

## Key facts
- Price: Free
- Account required: No
- Data privacy: All data stays in the user's browser
- Supported output: PDF
- Templates: Classic, Modern, Minimal, Executive, Creative
- ATS compatible: Yes
